WITH months AS ( SELECT 1 AS monthNum UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 ), revenue_monthly AS ( SELECT MONTH(entry_date) AS monthNum, ISNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM revenue_entries WHERE YEAR(entry_date) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(entry_date) ), operating_monthly AS ( SELECT MONTH(entry_date) AS monthNum, ISNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM expense_entries WHERE YEAR(entry_date) = #{year} AND is_proxy_payment = 0 AND (category IS NULL OR category <> N'货款') GROUP BY MONTH(entry_date) ), manual_supplier_monthly AS ( SELECT MONTH(entry_date) AS monthNum, ISNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM expense_entries WHERE YEAR(entry_date) = #{year} AND category = N'货款' GROUP BY MONTH(entry_date) ), other_monthly AS ( SELECT MONTH(entry_date) AS monthNum, ISNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM expense_entries WHERE YEAR(entry_date) = #{year} AND is_proxy_payment = 1 GROUP BY MONTH(entry_date) ), supplier_monthly AS ( SELECT monthNum, ISNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT MONTH(paid_date) AS monthNum, amount FROM supplier_payment_pending WHERE status = N'paid' AND paid_date IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(paid_date) = #{year} UNION ALL SELECT MONTH(entry_date) AS monthNum, amount FROM expense_entries WHERE category = N'货款' AND YEAR(entry_date) = #{year} ) supplier_rows GROUP BY monthNum ) SELECT #{year} AS year, m.monthNum AS month, ISNULL(r.amount, 0) AS totalRevenue, ISNULL(o.amount, 0) AS operatingExpense, ISNULL(s.amount, 0) AS supplierPaymentExpense, ISNULL(t.amount, 0) AS otherExpense, ISNULL(r.amount, 0) - ISNULL(o.amount, 0) - ISNULL(s.amount, 0) - ISNULL(t.amount, 0) AS netProfit FROM months m LEFT JOIN revenue_monthly r ON r.monthNum = m.monthNum LEFT JOIN operating_monthly o ON o.monthNum = m.monthNum LEFT JOIN supplier_monthly s ON s.monthNum = m.monthNum LEFT JOIN other_monthly t ON t.monthNum = m.monthNum ORDER BY m.monthNum
